# The Independent

> > The Independent is a British digital news publication delivering breaking news, analysis, and lifestyle content across politics, world affairs, travel, sport, and culture.

Founded in 1986, The Independent covers global news with focus on UK, US, and international stories including conflicts in Iran, political developments under Donald Trump, and major sporting events. The site features extensive travel guides, product reviews through IndyBest, student resources, and video content on climate and extreme weather.

## Key Topics

- Donald Trump
- Iran conflict and Middle East
- UK politics and news
- Climate and extreme weather
- Travel destinations (Spain, Italy, Greece, Canary Islands)
- Sports coverage (England rugby, UFC, Cheltenham)
- TUI and travel deals
- Independent TV video content
- IndyBest product reviews
- Student and university resources
- 30-year journalism history
- Breaking news and live updates
- Budget travel
- European destinations (Brussels, Belgium)
- Lifestyle and wellness

- [US job openings rise to a better-than-expected 7 million despite sluggish labor market](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/washington-commerce-department-donald-trump-labor-department-covid-b2938067.html): US job openings reach 7M in January per Labor Department data
- [Thieves target heating oil tanks as prices soar amid Iran war](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/thieves-heating-oil-suffolk-police-iran-war-b2937883.html): Suffolk heating oil theft surge as Iran war drives prices to £1.73/litre
